name: Marrow & Pin
short: A flash wall that inks itself as you scroll past each sheet.
long: Nine hand-drawn flash designs pinned up as paper sheets, each one drawn twice — a thin purple stencil and the finished black ink — with the ink filling in as the sheet crosses the middle of the screen. Filter the wall by artist, open a sheet for sizes, and the design carries through to a consultation form laid out like the studio's own paperwork, placement picked on a body outline instead of typed into a box.
proves: Your own drawings can be the website, and they can still take the booking.
features: Every design drawn twice and inked on scroll — stencil purple to black
Flash wall filtered by artist, with a sheet view and size options
Consultation form with a placement picker on a body outline
Guest-spot dates and the next free chair computed from today's date
Fresh-versus-healed toggle showing what a fine line does in a year
story: Built for the trades that sell by showing the work: the drawings are the design, so the page had to be made of them rather than of photographs of them.
